degradation_pattern: A subtle, low-intensity luminance noise that preserves underlying structural details with minimal visual obstruction, characterized by fine-grained textures primarily affecting mid-tones or darker regions without significant color artifacts.

High-intensity, fine-grained luminance-dominant noise characterized by pervasive random speckling that significantly reduces spatial correlation and obscures fine details across the entire visual field, including dark regions and text areas.
A moderate intensity noise pattern that falls between subtle and pervasive, affecting visibility but retaining some structural integrity, often characterized by mixed frequency components.
